Sandbox_DansVanillaFixesColdPackHours_to:
How long one fully frozen cold pack keeps a cooler cold, in game hours. Packs in the same cooler add up: three frozen packs last three times as long.
A fridge chills a pack half way, a freezer fully.
Sandbox_DansVanillaFixesItemInfoTooltips: Extra lines under an item's tooltip: the read time left on skill books and novels, uses left on drainables (a charge in percent for batteries), weapon numbers, and for clothing the body parts it covers and how it compares with what you wear in that slot.
Sandbox_DansVanillaFixesItemInfoWeaponSk:
On: a weapon shows more of its numbers as you level the skill it uses (damage at 1, critical chance at 2, speed and reach at 3, knockback and endurance at 4; Aiming for firearms), and Maintenance shows its condition and wear.
Off: every number shows from the start.
